Fate/Samurai Remnant Announced Releasing Worldwide in 2023.


Via the Fate Project New Year TV 2022, a new fate game has been announced titled Fate/Samurai Remnant along with the release of a teaser trailer.   Fate/Samurai Remnant is set to release in 2023 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam. The game is developed by KOEI TECMO and will be supervised by TYPE-MOON.



Related Posts   Pokemon Sleep Now Available In Malaysia   GamerBraves Newsletter Vol. 103 – The Glory of The Barbie/Oppenheimer Double Feature   Not much has been shown about the game, let alone the plot but from the teaser trailer, it seems a brand-new Holy Grail War has begun set in the Edo period.
While the identity of the two main characters were not revealed, we did get a glimpse of Miyamoto Musashi, Fate’s gender bent version of the legendary swordsman at the end of the teaser. She first debuted in Fate/Grand Order and was the main character during the Shimousa arc.

A little fun fact, the Miyamoto Musashi that appeared in FGO actually has the ability to jump between dimensions and the FGO universe was not her first. Whether her appearance in Samurai Remnant is part of her dimension hopping or actually her original world is still up in the air.
To recap, Fate/Samurai Remnant is an action RPG developed by KOEI TECMO releasing worldwide in 2023 for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam. The game will be available in English, Japanese and Chinese subtitles.
Do check out their official website and social media to get the latest information and updates for the game.

reference_summary: "Fate/Samurai Remnant," RPG aksi baharu oleh KOEI TECMO dan Type-Moon, akan dikeluarkan pada tahun 2023 untuk PS4, PS5, Switch dan PC. Permainan ini berlaku semasa zaman Edo dan menampilkan Perang Cawan Suci baharu. Treler penggoda mendedahkan Miyamoto Musashi, watak daripada "Fate/Grand Order," tetapi tidak jelas sama ada ini dunia asalnya atau dimensi lain. Permainan ini akan tersedia dalam sari kata Inggeris, Jepun dan Cina. Ikuti laman web rasmi dan media sosial untuk kemas kini.
